title: Microsoft allows antivirus software to run outside the Windows kernel
content_md:
Microsoft is allowing antivirus products to run outside the Windows kernel. In Windows 11, the platform supports antivirus software in user mode, reducing the impact of failures in the kernel.

via Mastodon https://guiadeti.com.br/noticias/microsoft-antivirus-fora-kernel-windows/
exclude_reason: General news about Windows user-mode antivirus platform, no security event or vulnerability.
